integrity: Analytic proof with exact Fourier and cotangent identities; independent finite numerical corroboration does not certify infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Even full one-dimensional lattices with N>=4, smoothness one, exact kernel and Chebyshev periodization density only; no subsampled or multivariate claim. Earlier periodic Sobolev literature leaves possible priority overlap.
title: Sharp linear-in-mesh positivity frontier for Chebyshev-periodized Korobov lattice cubature
